n, b = map(int, input().split())
numbers = list(map(int, input().split()))
signValues = [(-1 if num % 2 == 0 else 1) for num in numbers]

sumSigns = 0
edgeDifferences = []

for i in range(n - 1):
    sumSigns += signValues[i]
    if sumSigns == 0:
        diff = abs(numbers[i + 1] - numbers[i])
        edgeDifferences.append(diff)

edgeDifferences.sort()

totalCost = 0
maxEdgesSelected = 0
for diff in edgeDifferences:
    if totalCost + diff <= b:
        totalCost += diff
        maxEdgesSelected += 1

print(maxEdgesSelected)
